{{DISPLAYTITLE:paul (Tabletop Simulator)}}
'''paul''' is a Steam Workshop author who published Star Wars CCG Table With Booster Packs Scripted, a table for playing [[Star Wars CCG]] in [[Tabletop Simulator]].<ref name="paul" /> The Steam display name is written in lower case.

== Service ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Dates !! Service
|-
| 7 February 2021 &ndash; 22 March 2021 || Published Star Wars CCG Table With Booster Packs Scripted, a [[Tabletop Simulator]] Workshop table for [[Star Wars CCG]]<ref name="paul" />
|}
